name: Da Maria Bali
description: is a modern Italian restaurant in Seminyak, Bali, known for its Italo Dining concept that blends traditional Italian food with a lively, stylish atmosphere. Inspired by a 1960s Amalfi Coast courtyard, Da Maria serves wood-fired pizzas, fresh pasta, and signature cocktails. By night, it transforms into a buzzing late-night venue with top DJs and vibrant parties.
note:
